title: Panel defaults
description: What a panel takes where its lines say nothing, in millimetres.

$schema.description: the schema this file is written to

rail.description: how wide a frame's rail is

boardGap.description: between boards that are routed apart, and between them and the rails

fiducialOpening.description: the opening in the mask round it

tabWidth.description: how wide a mouse-bite tab is

tabSpacing.description: how much of a board's side one tab holds

biteDrill.description: a hole of a tab's row

bitePitch.description: between the holes of a row
